mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO okx_strategy_configuration (strategy_id, strategy_type, bar, config_version, params_json, reason, changed_at) VALUES (#{strategyId}, #{strategyType}, #{bar}, #{configVersion}, #{paramsJson}, #{reason}, #{changedAt})
